clue.text: Shell is clearly best for a vehicle at speed

parts.note: a car is a road vehicle
pace means rate of movement, speed

explanation.surface: A claim that a shell-shaped body is the ideal one for a car going fast.
explanation.definitionFit: The hard upper covering of a tortoise or crab is its protective outer case.

clue.text: Retreat when Bobby's on the beat

parts.note: a bobby is British slang for a policeman, a cop
a constable on the beat is out on patrol

explanation.surface: Something happening while the local policeman is walking his round.
explanation.walkthrough: A BOBBY is a British police officer, named after Sir Robert Peel; 'on the beat' means out patrolling.
explanation.definitionFit: To back out of a commitment is an idiomatic withdrawal, a feeble evasion.

clue.text: Set back by parliamentary adjournment

explanation.surface: A plan delayed because parliament has broken up for a holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: A wall alcove is set back from the line, and a legislature's holiday break is its adjournment period.

clue.text: Corrupt senior.PR man getting his deserts!

indicators.note: corrupt suggests the letters of the following words are spoiled and rearranged

explanation.surface: A crooked public-relations executive finally receiving the punishment he deserves.
explanation.walkthrough: The page prints 'senior.PR' run together; the fodder is SENIOR plus PR, eight letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone jailed for a crime is receiving his just punishment behind bars.

clue.text: Bill has a little girl

explanation.surface: A man called Bill and his young daughter.
explanation.definitionFit: A short written note of money owed, and an old word for a pert young woman or child.

clue.text: Refuse to take young dog around a ship

indicators.note: around tells us the pup's letters surround the next pieces

parts.note: a puppy, or pup, is a young dog
SS stands for steamship

explanation.surface: Declining to walk a puppy around a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: To decline an opportunity is to let it go by unused.

clue.text: The creator is a golden-headed Nordic god

indicators.note: headed says the gold piece goes at the top of this down entry

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold
Thor is the Norse god of thunder

explanation.surface: A claim that the maker of all is a fair-haired Scandinavian deity.
explanation.definitionFit: A writer is the originator, or maker, of a book or idea.

clue.text: Do a stunt in order to be conspicuous

indicators.note: in order hints at putting these letters into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Performing a daredevil trick to get noticed.
explanation.definitionFit: To be prominent, noticeably better or more visible than others.

clue.text: Quietly going ahead and presenting the case

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for quietly
leading means going in front, ahead

explanation.surface: A lawyer softly pressing on as they argue a client's case in court.
explanation.definitionFit: A lawyer arguing in court makes submissions on behalf of a client.

clue.text: Stop to add an item to one's case

definitions.text: to add an item to one's case

explanation.surface: Advice to quit while slipping one more thing into a suitcase.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiomatically to quit or give up; literally to pack something into luggage.

clue.text: A kid should be free from anxiety

parts.note: to kid someone is to tease or rib them

explanation.surface: A young goat, or a child, ought not to worry.
explanation.definitionFit: Relaxed and comfortable, without nerves or worry.

clue.text: Everyone immersed in educational journal probably does

indicators.note: immersed in places one piece inside the journal's letters

parts.note: TES is the Times Educational Supplement, a British teachers' paper
each means every one individually

explanation.surface: Every reader deeply absorbed in a schools magazine.
explanation.walkthrough: The TES (Times Educational Supplement) is a UK weekly for teachers; the definition reads the whole clue: such a paper probably instructs.
explanation.definitionFit: An educational paper presumably instructs its readers, which is what the verb implies.

clue.text: Consequence of firing a military salute?

explanation.surface: The result of soldiers discharging rifles skyward in honour.
explanation.definitionFit: The final outcome or result; whimsically, a round fired skyward in salute.

clue.text: Given support when temporarily transferred

explanation.surface: A motion backed during an officer's short-term posting elsewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: A motion backed in a meeting, and a worker posted to another department for a spell.

clue.text: A woman in poor accommodation is ashamed

indicators.note: in places the woman inside the following letters

parts.note: bad means of low quality, poor
she is the pronoun for a woman

explanation.surface: A woman living in shabby lodgings feels embarrassed by it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Poor accommodation' looks like a shed or hovel; 'poor' gives BAD and 'accommodation' merely suggests holding the woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Embarrassed or mortified, feeling sheepish about something.

clue.text: Return home to recover

explanation.surface: Coming home to recuperate.
explanation.definitionFit: To come back to the house, and to regain something lost.

clue.text: Destroy and decapitate a bear

indicators.note: decapitate means cut off the head, so the first letter goes

parts.note: Bruin is a traditional name for a bear in fable

explanation.surface: An order to wreck something and behead a bear.
explanation.definitionFit: To wreck or spoil completely, laying waste.

clue.text: Where coach travellers were conveyed by degrees

explanation.surface: Coach passengers of old travelling a little at a time.
explanation.definitionFit: Stagecoach travel went in legs between posting inns; also gradually, step by step.

clue.text: It's twice as costly, alas

indicators.note: twice means the costly piece is written two times over

parts.note: dear means expensive, costly

explanation.surface: A lament that something now costs double.
explanation.definitionFit: An exclamation of mild dismay or regret, like 'oh no'.

clue.text: Accountant with fantastic attire

parts.note: acc is a short form for accountant or account
outre means bizarre, fantastic, beyond the usual

explanation.surface: A bookkeeper turning up in outlandish clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: To clothe or equip someone, especially in military dress.

clue.text: The twelfth letter is missing from Christmas refrain

parts.note: no, as in 'no money', means none present, missing
the twelfth letter of the alphabet is L, spelt out as el

explanation.surface: A carol chorus with one particular letter dropped.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'The twelfth letter is missing' as 'no L', and spell L as the word EL.
explanation.definitionFit: A word sung as the repeated chorus of carols at Yuletide.

clue.text: Basic constituent in perfume

explanation.surface: The key ingredient of a fragrance.
explanation.definitionFit: The fundamental nature of a thing, and a concentrated fragrant extract or scent.

clue.text: Song he composed in Ancient Egypt

definitions.note: the definition describes a place located in ancient Egypt

indicators.note: composed suggests the letters are put together in a new order

explanation.surface: A man writing a song during the Pharaohs' time.
explanation.walkthrough: GOSHEN is the Biblical region of Egypt where the Israelites lived.
explanation.definitionFit: The Bible names this land in the Nile delta as the Israelites' home under the Pharaohs.

clue.text: Rex tucked into the basil sauce very quickly

indicators.note: tucked into places one piece inside another

parts.note: pesto is an Italian sauce of basil and pine nuts
R is short for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A king eating pasta with green sauce at speed.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical tempo marking meaning at a rapid pace.

clue.text: Recognition for upstanding C draughtsman

indicators.note: upstanding in a down entry means the word is written upwards, so read backwards

parts.note: a drawer is one who draws, a draughtsman

explanation.surface: An honest technical illustrator being given credit.
explanation.definitionFit: A prize or payment given in acknowledgement of merit.

clue.text: Think it's about someone else's go,

explanation.surface: A board-game player deciding the next move belongs to an opponent.
explanation.definitionFit: To turn something over in the mind is to ponder it; a turn that is finished passes play on.

clue.text: Sounds like the track is rough

indicators.note: sounds like tells us a word is heard rather than read

parts.note: a course is a track, as for racing

explanation.surface: A racetrack said to be in poor condition.
explanation.definitionFit: Crude or uneven in texture, harsh.

clue.text: Heartening reassurances found in the Qur'an

indicators.note: heartening is read as taking the heart, the central letters of the word

explanation.surface: Comforting promises discovered in Islamic scripture.
explanation.definitionFit: A chapter of the holy book of Islam is one of its divisions.

clue.text: Attempt short English article on German poet

parts.note: a go is a try or attempt
E is the abbreviation of English
the is the definite article

explanation.surface: Trying out a brief English essay about a German writer.
explanation.definitionFit: The author of Faust, Weimar's great literary figure.

clue.text: Left port and pâtés out for a change

indicators.note: for a change signals these letters are altered in order

explanation.surface: A ship departing and leaving its pâtés behind to vary the menu.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship that sails off from harbour heads for open water.

clue.text: Bound to get well

explanation.surface: Someone certain to recover from illness.
explanation.definitionFit: To leap or jump; also a natural water source rising from the ground.

clue.text: Reformed and was successful

explanation.surface: A former crook who turned straight and prospered.
explanation.definitionFit: Made amends for a fault, and achieved wealth or prosperity.
